articles.title: Antonelli and Mercedes complete clean sweep of practice sessions in Losail | Formula 1
articles.teaser: Mercedes drivers Andrea Kimi Antonelli and George Russell headed all three practice sessions for the Qatar Grand Prix.

articles.title: F1 Qatar GP: Antonelli takes clean sweep of top spot in practice
articles.teaser: Kimi Antonelli has handed Mercedes a clean sweep of Qatar Grand Prix practice sessions as the Silver Arrows head to Formula 1 qualifying with a huge advantage. George Russell went quickest before halfway as teams…

digest: Coverage of final practice in Qatar centred on Mercedes completing a clean sweep of the practice sessions, with Kimi Antonelli credited with sealing it. Antonelli and George Russell between them headed all three sessions at Losail (RaceFans). Both Motorsport.com and Autosport said the Silver Arrows head into qualifying with a huge advantage, and reported that Russell went quickest before halfway, with teams then embarking on soft-tyre runs (Motorsport.com).
